chunks: And ʿAbdullāh ibn Yaḥyā al-Kāhilī narrated; he said:
Aḥmad ibn al-Nuʿmān asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام and said to him: “I have a young bondwoman between whom and me there is no blood relation, and she is six years old.”
He عليه السلام said: “Do not place her in your lap.”

key_terms.جُوَيْرِيَةٌ: a young bondwoman or young female servant
key_terms.رَحِمٌ: blood relation or kinship tie creating familial closeness

ai.seo_question: At what age should a non-related young girl no longer be placed in a man's lap according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal and ethical instruction regarding physical closeness with a young girl who is not a mahram. The Imam عليه السلام prohibits placing her in one's lap, indicating the need for boundaries in interaction once a child reaches a certain age.
